Alexander.name: Alexander
Alexander.method:
Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes.
Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Alexander.garnish: Sprinkle fresh ground nutmeg on top.

Americano.name: Americano
Americano.method:
Mix the ingredients directly in an old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.
Add a splash of Soda Water. Stir gently.
Americano.garnish: Garnish with half orange slice and a lemon zest.

Angel Face.name: Angel Face
Angel Face.method:
Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes.
Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

Aviation.name: Aviation
Aviation.method:
Add all ingredients into a cocktail shaker.
Shake with cracked ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

Bee’s Knees.name: Bee’s Knees
Bee’s Knees.method: Stir honey with lemon and orange juices until it dissolves, add gin and shake with ice. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
Bee’s Knees.garnish: Optionally garnish with a lemon or orange zest.

Bellini.name: Bellini

Between the Sheets.name: Between the Sheets
Between the Sheets.method:
Add all ingredients into a cocktail shaker.
Shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

Black Russian.name: Black Russian
Black Russian.method:
Pour the ingredients into the old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.
Stir gently. strain ingredients into old fashioned glass filled with ice.
NOTE:
WHITE RUSSIAN – Float fresh cream on the top and stir in slowly.

Bloody Mary.name: Bloody Mary

ingredients.name: Tabasco, Celery Salt, Pepper (Up to taste)

Bloody Mary.method:
Stir gently all the ingredients in a mixing glass with ice, pour into rocks glass.
NOTE:
If requested served with ice, pour into highball glass.

Boulevardier.name: Boulevardier
Boulevardier.method:
Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes.
Stir well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
Boulevardier.garnish: Garnish with a orange zest, optionally a lemon zest.

Bramble.name: Bramble
Bramble.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker except the Crème de Mûre, shake well with ice, strain into chilled old fashioned glass filled with crushed ice, then pour the blackberry liqueur (Crème de Mûre) over the top of the drink, in a circular motion.
Bramble.garnish: Garnish optionally with a lemon slice and blackberries.

Brandy Crusta.name: Brandy Crusta
Brandy Crusta.method:
Mix together all ingredients with ice cubes in a mixing
glass and strain into a prepared slim cocktail glass.
Brandy Crusta.garnish:
Rub a slice of orange (or lemon) around the rim of the glass and dip it in
pulverized white sugar, so that the sugar will adhere to the edge of the glass.
Carefully curling place the orange/lemon peel around the inside of the glass.

Caipirinha.name: Caipirinha
Caipirinha.method:
Place lime and sugar into a double old fashioned glass and muddle gently.
Fill the glass with cracked ice and add Cachaça. Stir gently to involve ingredients.
Note:
Caipiroska – Instead of Cachaça use Vodka;
Caipirissima – Instead of Cachaça use Rum.
Caipirão – Instead of Cachaça use Licor Beirão.

Canchanchara.name: Canchanchara
Canchanchara.method:
Mix honey with water and lime juice and spread the mixture on the bottom and sides of the glass.
Add cracked ice, and then the rum.
End by energetically stirring from bottom to top.

Cardinale.name: Cardinale
Cardinale.method:
Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well.
Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Casino.name: Casino
Casino.method:
Pour all ingredients into cocktails shaker, shake well with ice, strain
into chilled rocks glass with ice.
Casino.garnish: Garnish with a lemon zest and a maraschino cherry.

Champagne Cocktail.name: Champagne Cocktail
Champagne Cocktail.method:
Place the sugar cube with 2 dashes of bitters in a large Champagne glass, add the cognac.
Pour gently chilled Champagne.
Champagne Cocktail.garnish: Garnish with orange zest and maraschino cherry.

Chartreuse Swizzle.name: Chartreuse Swizzle
Chartreuse Swizzle.method:
Pour all ingredients into a tall glass, add pebble ice.
With the help of a swizzle stick (or cocktail spoon) mix vigorously, complete by filling the glass with more pebble ice.
Chartreuse Swizzle.garnish: Garnish with mint leaves and grated nutmeg.

Clover Club.name: Clover Club
Clover Club.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktails shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Corpse Reviver #2.name: Corpse Reviver #2
Corpse Reviver #2.method:
Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice.
Shake well and strain in chilled cocktail glass.

Cosmopolitan.name: Cosmopolitan
Cosmopolitan.method:
Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice.
Shake well and strain into large cocktail glass.

Cuba Libre.name: Cuba Libre
Cuba Libre.method: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.

Daiquiri.name: Daiquiri
Daiquiri.method:
In a cocktail shaker add all ingredients. Stir well to dissolve the sugar.
Add ice and shake. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Dark ‘N’ Stormy.name: Dark ‘N’ Stormy
Dark ‘N’ Stormy.method: In a highball glass filled with ice pour the ginger beer and top floating with the Rum.
Dark ‘N’ Stormy.garnish: Garnish with a lime wedge or slice.

Dry Martini.name: Dry Martini
Dry Martini.method:
Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well.
Strain into chilled martini cocktail glass.
Dry Martini.garnish: Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink, or garnish with a green olives if requested.

Espresso Martini.name: Espresso Martini
Espresso Martini.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

French 75.name: French 75
French 75.method:
Pour all the ingredients, except Champagne, into a shaker.
Shake well and strain into a Champagne flute.
Top up with Champagne.
Stir gently.

French Martini.name: French Martini
French Martini.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.
French Martini.garnish: Squeeze oil from lemon peel onto the drink.

Gin Fizz.name: Gin Fizz
Gin Fizz.method:
Shake all ingredients with ice except soda water.
Pour into thin tall Tumbler glass , top with a splash soda water.
NOTE:
Serve without ice.
Gin Fizz.garnish: Garnish with lemon slice, optional lemon zest.

Grasshopper.name: Grasshopper
Grasshopper.method:
Pour all ingredients into shaker filled with ice.
Shake briskly for few seconds. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Hemingway Special.name: Hemingway Special
Hemingway Special.method:
Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake well and strain into a large cocktail glass.

Irish Coffee.name: Irish Coffee
Irish Coffee.method:
Warm black coffee is poured into a preheated Irish coffee glass.
Whiskey and at least one teaspoon of sugar is added and stirred until dissolved.
Fresh thick chilled cream is carefully poured over the back of a spoon held just above the surface of the coffee.
The layer of cream will float on the coffee without mixing.
Plain sugar can be replaced with sugar syrup

John Collins.name: John Collins
John Collins.method:
Pour all ingredients directly into highball filled with ice. Stir gently.
NOTE:
Use ‘Old Tom’ Gin for Tom Collins.
John Collins.garnish: Garnish with lemon slice and maraschino cherry.

Kir.name: Kir
Kir.method:
Pour Crème de Cassis into glass, top up with white wine.
NOTE:
Kir Royal – Use Champagne instead of white wine

Long Island Iced Tea.name: Long Island Iced Tea
Long Island Iced Tea.method:
Add all ingredients into highball glass filled with ice.
Stir gently.

Mai-Tai.name: Mai-Tai
Mai-Tai.method:
Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake and pour into a double rocks glass or an highball glass.
* The Martinique molasses rum used by Trader Vic was not an Agricole Rhum but a type of “rummy” from molasses.
Mai-Tai.garnish: Garnish with pineapple spear, mint leaves and lime peel.

Manhattan.name: Manhattan
Manhattan.method:
Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes.
Stir well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Margarita.name: Margarita
Margarita.method:
Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

Martinez.name: Martinez
Martinez.method:
Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes.
Stir well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Mary Pickford.name: Mary Pickford
Mary Pickford.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Mimosa.name: Mimosa
Mimosa.method:
Pour orange juice into flute glass and gently pour the sparkling wine.
Stir gently.
NOTE:
Also known as Buck’s Fizz.

Mint Julep.name: Mint Julep
Mint Julep.method:
In Julep Stainless Steel Cup gently muddle the mint with sugar and water.
Fill the glass with cracked ice, add the Bourbon and stir well until the cup frosts.

Mojito.name: Mojito
Mojito.method:
Mix mint springs with sugar and lime juice.
Add splash of soda water and fill the glass with ice.
Pour the rum and top with soda water. Light stir to involve all ingredients.
Mojito.garnish: Garnish with sprigs of mint and slice of lime.

Moscow Mule.name: Moscow Mule
Moscow Mule.method:
In an Mule Cup or rocks glass, combine the vodka and ginger beer.
Add lime juice and gently stir to involve all ingredients.

Negroni.name: Negroni
Negroni.method:
Pour all ingredients directly into chilled old fashioned glass filled with ice.
Stir gently.

New York Sour.name: New York Sour
New York Sour.method:
Pour all ingredients into the shaker. Shake vigorously with ice.
Strain into a chilled rocks glass filled with ice. Float the wine on top.
New York Sour.garnish: Garnish with lemon or orange zest with cherry.

Old Fashioned.name: Old Fashioned
Old Fashioned.method:
Place sugar cube in old fashioned glass and saturate with bitter, add few dashes of plain water. Muddle until dissolved. Fill the glass with ice cubes and add whiskey.
Stir gently.
Old Fashioned.garnish: Garnish with orange slice or zest, and a cocktail cherry.

Paloma.name: Paloma
Paloma.method:
Poor the tequila into a highball glass, squeeze the lime juice.
Add ice and salt, fill up pink grapefruit soda.
Stir gently.
Paloma.garnish: Garnish with a slice of lime.

Paper Plane.name: Paper Plane
Paper Plane.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Penicillin.name: Penicillin
Penicillin.method:
Muddle fresh ginger in a shaker and add the remaining ingredients except for the Islay single malt whisky.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake.
Fine train into a chilled Old Fashioned glass with ice.
Float the single malt whisky on top.

Pina Colada.name: Pina Colada
Pina Colada.method:
Blend all the ingredients with ice in a electric blender,
pour into a large glass and serve with straws.
Note:
Historically a few drops of fresh lime juice was added to taste. 4 slices of fresh pineapple can be used instead of juice
Pina Colada.garnish: Garnish with a slice of pineapple with a cocktail cherry.

Pisco Sour.name: Pisco Sour
Pisco Sour.method:
Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice.
Shake and strain into a chilled goblet glass.
Pisco Sour.garnish: Few dashes of Amargo bitters on top as an aromatic garnish.

Planters Punch.name: Planters Punch
Planters Punch.method:
Pour all ingredients directly in a small tumbler or a typical terracotta glass.
NOTE:
Add dilution up to taste, it can be given by water, ice or fresh juices.

Porto Flip.name: Porto Flip
Porto Flip.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Porn Star Martini.name: Porn Star Martini

ingredients.name: ml Champagne to serve on the side

Porn Star Martini.method:
Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, double strain into a large chilled cocktail glass.
Accompany with a shot of champagne.
Porn Star Martini.garnish: Garnish with passion fruit cup and sugar.

Rusty Nail.name: Rusty Nail
Rusty Nail.method:
Pour all ingredients directly into an old fashioned glass filled with ice.
Stir gently.

Sazerac.name: Sazerac
Sazerac.method:
Rinse a chilled old-fashioned glass with the absinthe, add crushed ice and set it aside. Stir the remaining ingredients over ice in a mixing glass.
Discard the ice and any excess absinthe from the prepared glass, strain the mixed drink into the glass.
NOTE:
The original recipe changed after the American Civil War, Rye Whiskey substituted Cognac as it became hard to obtain.

Sea Breeze.name: Sea Breeze
Sea Breeze.method: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
Sea Breeze.garnish: Garnish with an orange zest and cherry.

Sex on the Beach.name: Sex on the Beach
Sex on the Beach.method: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.

Sidecar.name: Sidecar
Sidecar.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Singapore Sling.name: Singapore Sling
Singapore Sling.method:
Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes.
Shake well.
Strain into Hurricane glass.
Singapore Sling.garnish: Garnish with pineapple and maraschino cherry.

Spritz.name: Spritz
Spritz.method:
Build all ingredients into a wine glass filled with ice.
Stir gently.
NOTE:
There are other versions of the Spritz that use Campari, Cynar or Select instead of Aperol.
Spritz.garnish: Garnish with a slice of orange.

Stinger.name: Stinger
Stinger.method:
Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Stir well.
Strain into chilled martini cocktail glass.

Tequila Sunrise.name: Tequila Sunrise
Tequila Sunrise.method:
Pour tequila and orange juice directly into highball glass filled with ice cubes.
Add the grenadine syrup to create chromatic effect (sunrise), do not stir.
Tequila Sunrise.garnish: Garnish with half orange slice or an orange zest.

Trinidad Sour.name: Trinidad Sour
Trinidad Sour.method:
Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, shake well with ice.
Strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Vesper.name: Vesper
Vesper.method:
Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice cubes.
Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

Whiskey Sour.name: Whiskey Sour
Whiskey Sour.method:
Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well.
Strain into cobbler glass. If served “On the rocks”, strain ingredients
into old fashioned glass filled with ice.
NOTE:
If egg white is used shake little harder to release and incorporate the foam from the egg white.
Whiskey Sour.garnish: Garnish with half orange slice and maraschino cherry, optionally use orange zest.

White Lady.name: White Lady
White Lady.method: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

Zombie.name: Zombie
Zombie.method:
Add all ingredients into an electric blender with 170 grams of cracked ice.
With pulse bottom blend for a few seconds. Serve in a tall tumbler glass.
Note:
*Donn’s Mix: 2 parts of fresh yellow grapefruit and 1 part of cinnamon syrup
